name: RenderDoc MCP Server
description: Exposes an MCP (Model Context Protocol) broker over local HTTP. Every instance running this extension registers with the broker; AI Agents can list instances, launch programs under capture control, load .rdc captures from disk (including manually captured ones) and inspect them: drawcall list, pipeline state, screenshots (region/scale/save-to), pixel history, shader disassembly, buffer regions/search/vertex decode and debug messages.
